verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Salesforce MCP server is published at github.com/salesforcecli/mcp, so an external agent can connect to Salesforce (including Sales Cloud org data) through first-party MCP tooling. The evidence is a single probe line with no detail on what the server exposes or how to set it up; the AgentExchange item about plugging MCP servers into Agentforce is client-side and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's tools and coverage of Sales Cloud objects, setup and auth instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
